commands.name: Show Hugging Face CLI help
commands.description: Show the available Hugging Face Hub CLI command groups.

commands.name: Sign in to Hugging Face Hub
commands.description: Save a Hugging Face access token for authenticated Hub operations.

commands.name: Show Hugging Face account
commands.description: Show the account associated with the current Hugging Face token.

commands.name: Download a Hugging Face model
commands.description: Download a repository snapshot from the Hugging Face Hub to the local cache.

commands.name: Download a file from a Hub repository

commands.name: Download a specific model revision
commands.description: Download a particular branch, tag, or commit from a Hub repository.

commands.description: Show cached Hub repositories and disk usage.

commands.description: Interactively remove cached revisions that are no longer referenced.
